description:
[Web DOM inspection. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Identifies installed Consent Management Platforms (Iubenda, Cookiebot, OneTrust, Didomi), audits Google Consent Mode v2 implementation, and detects unconsented third-party tracking scripts loaded prior to user consent.
Usage: Use this tool to audit cookie consent compliance under GDPR Article 7. For cookie banner deceptive design and dark pattern checks, use 'cookie_dark_patterns' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { cmpDetected: string | null, consentModeV2: { enabled: boolean, defaultState: string }, preConsentTrackersFound: string[], gdprComplianceStatus: 'COMPLIANT' | 'NON_COMPLIANT', violations: string[] }.

htmlContent.description: Raw HTML content if URL cannot be fetched directly

url.description: Target website URL to fetch and audit (e.g. https://novapixel.it)

name: gdpr_cmp_tracker_audit
